<RuleLanguageLinks current="css" languages={[{"id":"css","label":"CSS","href":"/linter/rules/use-logical-properties/css/"}]} />

:::caution
This rule is part of the [nursery](/linter/#nursery) group. This means that it is experimental and the behavior can change at any time.
:::
## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.5.15`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/useLogicalProperties`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule has an [**unsafe**](/linter/#unsafe-fixes) fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**warning**](/reference/diagnostics#warning).
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`csstools/use-logical`](https://github.com/stylelint/stylelint/blob/main/lib/rules/csstools/use-logical/README.md)
  - Same as [`liberty/use-logical-spec`](https://github.com/stylelint/stylelint/blob/main/lib/rules/liberty/use-logical-spec/README.md)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"useLogicalProperties": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Prefer logical CSS properties over physical properties.

Physical properties such as `left`, `margin-left`, and `width` describe fixed directions or
dimensions. Logical properties such as `inset-inline-start`, `margin-inline-start`, and
`inline-size` adapt when text runs right to left or uses a vertical writing mode.

## Examples

### Invalid

```css
p {
  margin: 1px 2px;
}
```

### Valid

```css
p {
  inline-size: 100%;
  inset-block-start: 0;
  margin-inline-start: 1rem;
  border-inline-start: 1px solid;
  float: inline-start;
  text-align: end;
  justify-content: start;
  inline-size: anchor-size(self-inline);
  block-size: anchor-size(self-block);
  inset-block-start: anchor(end);
}
```

A multi-value physical shorthand always applies values to physical sides. Use separate
logical properties when values differ by axis. A four-sided shorthand is only equivalent
when all four values are identical, so the rule does not combine differing axis values
into one. Shorthands containing `var()`, `env()`, `attr()`, `if()`, or a SCSS variable are
reported without an automatic fix because these values can expand to multiple values. Check the
substitution before splitting the shorthand manually.

```css
p {
  margin: 1px;
  margin: var(--spacing);
  margin-block: 1px 2px;
  color: red;
}
```

```scss
$spacing: 1rem;

p {
  margin: $spacing 2px;
}
```

Visit </span><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\"><a href=\"https://biomejs.dev/linter/#nursery\">https://biomejs.dev/linter/#nursery</a></span><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\"> for more information.</span><br />  <br /></code></pre>"} />

## Options

### `direction`

Sets the text direction used to replace left and right properties and to order the inline
values when splitting a four-value physical shorthand. Use `"ltr"` for left-to-right text
or `"rtl"` for right-to-left text. Defaults to `"ltr"`.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"useLogicalProperties": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"direction": "rtl"
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

#### Invalid

```css
p {
  margin-left: 1rem;
}
```
